name: Katni

queries.query: Katni Madhya Pradesh official cadastral map land records GIS parcel map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Katni district administration site, its district map page, the Government of India DILRMP Katni map-digitization status page, and the Madhya Pradesh MP Bhulekh land-record/map service. No open citywide parcel-vector download was identified.

queries.query: कटनी मध्य प्रदेश आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा भूमि अभिलेख
queries.result: First-party discovery returned the official Katni Hindi district site and MP Bhulekh references. Official service descriptions identify MP Bhulekh as the Madhya Pradesh land-record portal for searchable records and certified khasra/khatauni/naksha copies, but no public parcel geometry response was obtained.

registryBasis: The official Katni district administration site identifies Katni district and links the district map; Government of India DILRMP identifies Katni district's cadastral-map status; Madhya Pradesh government service information identifies MP Bhulekh as the authorized land-record and map portal. This evidences a state/local revenue workflow, not an open citywide parcel-vector API.

officialSources.observation: Official District Katni administration site; identifies Katni and links the district map and GIS-related public services.
Current official district map page embeds a Google map centered near Katni; it is not a cadastral parcel viewer.
Government of India DILRMP Katni page for cadastral-map digitization/georeferencing status; status metadata only, no parcel geometry endpoint.
Madhya Pradesh government e-service description lists land-record search and certified khasra, khatauni and naksha services.
Current MP Bhulekh WebGIS public entry page is JavaScript-only and displays a security notice.

requests.outcome: TLS-verified HTML retrieved; official district site and public links inspected.
TLS-verified HTML retrieved; current page contains a Google Maps embed centered near Katni, with no cadastral layer or parcel API.
Anonymous TLS-verified GET timed out after 25 seconds; no HTML, configuration, schema or geometry was received.
Public page is JavaScript-only and returned a security notice in the web reader; direct anonymous curl timed out after 20 seconds, so current JS/config/API routes could not be inspected.
Government of India Katni cadastral-status page was available through first-party discovery; it exposes program/status metadata, not parcel polygons or a public query endpoint.
Government service description was available through first-party discovery; it describes land-record and certified map procedures without publishing geometry.

source: Madhya Pradesh MP Bhulekh/WebGIS and official Katni district administration/DILRMP references
